name: adm_bw64
character: Object-based delivery: every placed track is its own channel with its position over time written as ADM metadata, plus the reverb return as a stereo bed. The playback renderer places the objects on the loudspeakers that are there.
label: ADM BW64 objects
sources: ITU-R BS.2076-2 (Audio Definition Model) for the metadata, ITU-R BS.2088-1 (BW64) for the axml and chna chunks
channels is 0 because the file has one channel per object: the count is the piece's, not the format's
An open-standard ADM file. It is not a Dolby Atmos master file and has not been through any vendor's certification
